title: Jellyfish
meta: Output: 4K/HD digital video (MP4/MOV), seamless loop; USB, download, or NFT
statement:
A meditative journey through fluid presence and emotional stillness, expressed through sculptural, light-infused jellyfish in motion. The work evokes a state of gentle drift — a moment between thoughts, between movements — where time feels suspended.

Inspired by Gilles Deleuze’s idea of lignes de fuite, nothing in this world remains fixed.

Each form dissolves, transforms, and re-emerges. The jellyfish become emotional architecture: delicate, impermanent, alive.
